description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of next token predictions over training steps for a model, with three distinct lines representing different training regimes or configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Step," uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 60,000, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)," uses a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with major gridlines and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The blue line, marked with solid blue circles, starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.25 at step 0, drops sharply to around 0.10 by step 10,000, and then rises steadily to approximately 0.40 by step 60,000. The teal line, marked with solid teal circles, begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.27 at step 0, drops to approximately 0.10 by step 10,000, and then rises steadily to approximately 0.40 by step 60,000. A third, fainter line is visible near the top right, marked with light gray circles and labeled "EX2A," which starts near 0.40 at step 0 and remains relatively flat, hovering around 0.40 to 0.42 across the entire range of steps shown.
